prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1293; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the rear quarter panel and driver-side door shows scrape marks, a cracked taillight lens, and a bent mirror bracket, all consistent with a sideswipe during a lane change. The damage pattern lines up with the reported impact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known. Labor hours for panel straightening, refinishing, and light replacement fit the extent of the damage. Two similar charges posted on the same day are under review with the shop before final approval. Recommended plan: replace the mirror assembly and taillight, repair and refinish the door and quarter panel, then recheck alignment of the door gap.
